body: Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called the impeachment effort against him a farce and a stunt during a press conference on Tuesday, Dawn,ABC Australia,The Hindu
Republican Representative Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth on Tuesday, The Straits Times,Al Jazeera
Lawmakers are expected to vote on the articles of impeachment introduced by Representative Thomas Massie later this week, The Hill,NPR
If the House approves the charges, the process will move to a Senate trial, The Hill,NPR
The chamber voted 211 to 204 in favor of a motion to refer the impeachment charges to the Republican-led House Judiciary Committee, effectively stopping the effort to impeach Hegseth, 0

The Hindu reported that U.S. Republicans derailed the bid to impeach Hegseth, The Hindu
en.context: Representative Thomas Massie introduced eight articles of impeachment against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, citing his conduct in office. Hegseth has denied wrongdoing and called the effort politically motivated.
